doc.brief: Used by list widgets to represent the headers they display.
doc.md:
Used by list widgets to represent the headers they display.

`GtkListHeader` objects are managed just like [`ListItem`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ListItem)
objects via their factory, but provide a different set of properties suitable
for managing the header instead of individual items.

get_child.brief: Gets the child previously set via gtk_list_header_set_child() or `NULL` if none was set.
get_child.md:
Gets the child previously set via gtk_list_header_set_child() or
`NULL` if none was set.

get_end.brief: Gets the end position in the model of the section that `self` is currently the header for.
get_end.md:
Gets the end position in the model of the section that `self` is
currently the header for.

If `self` is unbound, %GTK_INVALID_LIST_POSITION is returned.

get_item.brief: Gets the model item at the start of the section.
get_item.md:
Gets the model item at the start of the section.
This is the item that occupies the list model at position
[`ListHeader:start`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ListHeader#property:start).

If `self` is unbound, this function returns `NULL`.

get_n_items.brief: Gets the the number of items in the section.
get_n_items.md:
Gets the the number of items in the section.

If `self` is unbound, 0 is returned.

get_start.brief: Gets the start position in the model of the section that `self` is currently the header for.
get_start.md:
Gets the start position in the model of the section that `self` is
currently the header for.

If `self` is unbound, %GTK_INVALID_LIST_POSITION is returned.

set_child.brief: Sets the child to be used for this listitem.
set_child.md:
Sets the child to be used for this listitem.

This function is typically called by applications when
setting up a header so that the widget can be reused when
binding it multiple times.

end.brief: The first position no longer part of this section.
end.md: The first position no longer part of this section.

item.brief: The item at the start of the section.
item.md: The item at the start of the section.

n-items.brief: Number of items in this section.
n-items.md: Number of items in this section.

start.brief: First position of items in this section.
start.md: First position of items in this section.
